items.title: Finite locally free sheaves with isomorphic endomorphism algebras differ by an invertible twist
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma recovers a finite locally free sheaf from its endomorphism algebra: if SheafHom_O(F, F) and SheafHom_O(G, G) are isomorphic as O_S-algebras, then F and G differ by an invertible twist inducing that isomorphism (statement lines 9483-9495). The non-formal content is the construction: inside SheafHom(F, G) one takes the O_S-submodule L generated by the local isomorphisms whose conjugation is the given algebra isomorphism (proof lines 9501-9504), and then has to see that this L is invertible and that the evaluation F tensor L -> G is an isomorphism (proof lines 9505-9511). The author discharges both by an explicit reduction to the case of finite free modules over an affine base, where the two statements are direct matrix computations. The claim is H2: one construction plus two routine local verifications which the author delegates to the stated reduction.
